description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) used in the savings component of the Fineract project to represent different types of pre-closure penal interest application periods.

classes.name: PreClosurePenalInterestOnType
classes.description: An enum representing the types of pre-closure penal interest periods, including INVALID, WHOLE_TERM, and TILL_PREMATURE_WITHDRAWAL.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding enum constant, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all enum constants except INVALID.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is INVALID.

methods.name: isWholeTerm
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is WHOLE_TERM.

methods.name: isTillPrematureWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is TILL_PREMATURE_WITHDRAWAL.
